name: worktree-guard
description: Hooks that keep edits out of a repository's main checkout: blocks apply_patch edits targeting a main checkout, plus a SessionStart rule telling Codex to work in a git worktree.

interface.shortDescription: Keep edits out of a repository's main checkout.
interface.longDescription: A PreToolUse hook resolves the repository of every file an apply_patch call touches and denies the edit when any file is in a main checkout rather than a linked git worktree. Codex hooks cannot prompt, so the edit is blocked outright; launch Codex with WORKTREE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 to allow main-checkout edits for a session. A SessionStart hook adds the worktree rule to the model's context. Shell-based writes are not intercepted.
